What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Once an order has already shipped, changes (such as modifying items or the shipping address) are generally no longer possible while the package is in transit. 
If you no longer want the item after it ships, you still have a couple of options:
Refuse the delivery when the courier arrives (if the courier allows it), and the package will be returned. 
Accept the delivery and start a return after receiving it under the return policy.
So modifications must be requested before dispatch, but returns are still possible after delivery.
